description: This PHP class 'Difference' provides methods to calculate the interval difference between two dates in various units (days, months, years, etc.). It handles multiple input formats, including Excel serial dates, PHP DateTime objects, strings, and arrays of date values. The core function 'interval' computes the date difference based on specified units and accounts for leap years and date adjustments.

classes.name: Difference
classes.description: Provides methods to calculate various date differences, supporting multiple input formats and date calculations in PHP.

methods.name: interval
methods.description: Calculates the interval between two dates in specified units, supporting array inputs for batch processing.

methods.name: initialDiff
methods.description: Computes initial difference in service-specific date format, throwing exception if start date is after end date.

methods.name: replaceRetValue
methods.description: Helps determine whether to set the return value based on current unit and comparison unit.

methods.name: datedifD
methods.description: Returns the difference in days as an integer.

methods.name: datedifM
methods.description: Returns the difference in months, calculated from year and month differences.

methods.name: datedifMD
methods.description: Calculates day difference within partial months, considering date adjustments.

methods.name: datedifY
methods.description: Returns the difference in years from a DateInterval object.

methods.name: datedifYD
methods.description: Calculates day difference ignoring full years, adjusting for leap years.

methods.name: datedifYM
methods.description: Returns the difference in months ignoring years.
